Name: Seasonal Colored Seeds
Author: laulajatar
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Colored Seeds[/size][/b][/center]

[size=3][b][color=#e69138]· - =[/color] [color=#f6b26b]| D[/color][color=#f9cb9c]es[/color][color=#fce5cd]c[color=#ffffff]ri[/color]pt[/color][color=#f9cb9c]io[/color][color=#f6b26b]n |[/color][color=#e69138] = - · [/color][/b][/size]

This mod changes the color of seeds according to the season in which they grow.
Spring seeds are light green.
Summer seeds are pink.
Autumn seeds are brown.
Winter seeds are blue.
Seeds that grow in several seasons have mixed colors.

Seeds that have no seed packages, but are only the produce (like rice or sunflower seeds) have optional new sprites, matching the rest. Replacing them is turned on by default.

A config file will be created after you've run the game the first time with this mod installed.
There you can turn off the changes to seeds that use altered sprites.
You can also turn on changes to Cactus Seeds (makes them yellow in 1.5 to stand out more from the ones that can grow outside).
